description: This file implements the ApproximateClockToUnixTimeConverter class, providing methods to measure and convert approximate clock times to Unix time, including calibration and scaling logic.

classes.name: ApproximateClockToUnixTimeConverter
classes.description: A class for measuring and converting approximate clock times to Unix time, including calibration and scaling.

methods.name: ApproximateClockToUnixTimeConverter()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes start times by measuring pairs of clock samples.

methods.name: measurePair()
methods.description: Measures a pair of approximate and wall clock times to calibrate the clock.

methods.name: measurePairs()
methods.description: Performs multiple measurements to establish start and end times for calibration.

methods.name: makeConverter()
methods.description: Creates a function to convert approximate clock times to Unix time, applying calibration and scaling.
